Name: D_0
dialogue: Time to hook up with Thran816. I'd like some quality human-to-human dialogue.

Name: D_1
dialogue: *You boot up Chaotic and ring up Thran816*

Name: D_2
dialogue: (Thran and I have been friends for as long as I have had internet access. We have been playing duos in ROL ranked for almost 10 years now. Despite 10 years of trying, we never quite reached the prestigious champion rank.)

Name: D_3
dialogue: (If we both dropped out of college, however, we could have made it. At least that is how I cope.)

Name: D_4
dialogue: Hello? Hello?

Name: D_5
dialogue: Hey Thran. Are you still buzzed?

Name: D_6
dialogue: Hey! Are you still trash? You don't get to call me that after those ranked matches a couple of days ago. You threw those games so hard.

Name: D_7
dialogue: Don't act like you were playing well either!

Name: D_8
dialogue: Bailey!

Name: D_9
dialogue: Like you literally walked into turrent 3 times in a game and DIED. You are a ranged support main, how do you do that, dude?!

Name: D_10
dialogue: Please! That was the last game of the night. I was drunk and taking shots every time you missed the minions.

Name: D_11
dialogue: I was lagging! I haven't been able to reboot my PC for the past month because of my programming project.

Name: D_12
dialogue: Besides. Why are you drinking during ranked? You can barely play the game while sober!

Name: D_13
dialogue: Did you really ping me to talk about that terrible night? Because I kind of want to forget about it.

Name: D_14
dialogue: Eh? I am just trying to get my mind off of some stuff. Being in this stuffy room is starting to get to me.

Name: D_15
dialogue: What? Are you actually thinking of…

Name: D_16
dialogue: Going…o

Name: D_17
dialogue: Ah-O-ou-ow-out… outside?

Name: D_18
dialogue: Naw, the job market is not much of an improvement out there.

Name: D_19
dialogue: Ah, okay. Sorry, I thought you had lost your mind. I was worried for a moment that you were going to leave me as the only shut-in in this city

Name: D_20
dialogue: By the way, you still haven't found a job yet? You are such a talented programmer. How is that so?

Name: D_21
dialogue: No need to rub it in…

Name: D_22
dialogue: The AI tech sector is practically closed off to recruits ever since the war. I don't know why, but I haven't been able to network or contact anyone over there.

Name: D_23
dialogue: I have to assume the government is getting more intertwined with tech companies, and they've become either very selective or very secretive about who gets hired. So now I am stuck with whatever opportunities pop up.

Name: D_24
dialogue: You are lucky you decided to graduate earlier, before the tech sector kicked rocks. I really should have locked in more during my high school years.

Name: D_25
dialogue: It is not like I had much of a choice. I had no one to turn to if I went broke.

Name: D_26
dialogue: … You're right, I am sorry.

Name: D_27
dialogue: There is nothing to apologize for.

Name: D_28
dialogue: Do you want to play ROL? I don't have work today, and I am kinda bored.
